theme: An open day with a few clocks quietly running out.
greeting: The day is mostly yours, Dan — one call this afternoon and nothing else on the calendar. The pressure today isn't the schedule, it's a cluster of travel decisions whose windows are closing.

needsAttention.title: December trip needs a call today
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by date was Sept 30 and the book-by is Oct 15 — six people over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year. Pick domestic (nothing to wait on) or international (refundable only, since passports land mid-November).

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV before it sells out
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market, and the Pathfinder is south by then. A refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk; this has been open since Sept 14.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south starts Monday
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week is the plan for the Portland-to-St Pete drive. Dates and the one hotel night still need setting before the window opens.

needsAttention.title: Three term-life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Deliberately parked until after Croatia and now a week overdue. Still missing the target coverage amount and term length before you can shop.
